keyDates.text: FY2026 ends: ~$180M in IES research funds expire if not obligated by midnight. Judge ordered ED to report to court today (Sept 28) on spending progress.
FY2027 begins. Congress must pass appropriations or another continuing resolution to avoid a new government shutdown.
FAFSA 2027-28 statutory public launch deadline -- ED launched four days early on Sept 23, marking earliest in program history.
Status conference in Presidents Alliance v. DHS: federal court to revisit nationwide injunction blocking DHS four-year F-1/J-1 visa cap.
Current continuing resolution expires. Congress must act on FY2027 full-year appropriations or risk shutdown heading into winter recess.
Brown CIO Jane Dietze's last day. Deputy CIO Joshua Kennedy '97 assumes leadership of Brown's $8B endowment effective Jan 1, 2027.
Regular Decision deadline for Harvard, Yale, Columbia, Brown, Penn, and Stanford for Class of 2031 applications.
National Candidates Reply Date: deadline for admitted students to commit to their institution of enrollment for Fall 2027.

charts.title: Brown Endowment Growth Under CIO Jane Dietze (2018-2025)
charts.footnote: Brown's endowment grew from $3.8B to $8B under Dietze (2018-2025), performance in top 5% of endowments per Cambridge Associates. Still lowest in the Ivy League.
